## What does this PR do?

Describe the change and the motivation. Link related issues with "Fixes #123" when applicable.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran the test suite locally with `uv run pytest` and it passes
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the change, when applicable
- [ ] I updated the documentation (README, docs/), when applicable
- [ ] The change is focused, one topic per PR
